title: Seems expensive, but if you drink tea, totally worth it
text:
I vacillate between the Pure box and the Original box.

It's so, so good. Obviously great quality, obviously had care put into it. I got this for myself as a splurge for my birthday, but I'll be keeping the subscription, despite the fact that I have a super tight budget. The psychological benefits alone... oof. I'm easily drinking 500+% more tea than I did before, and it has become life.

Huge fan, here.
label: positive
